propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock assertions in tests cause CI flakes under runner contention; a detector with regex+escapes catches all cases with zero false positives
Two specific test sites (test_config_perf.py:201 and test_enrich_drain.py:261) must migrate from timing assertions to counting proxies (cache/drain spies) with regression-detection companions

The detector blocks unescaped upper-bound asserts via two legitimate escapes: '# timing: hang-guard — <reason>' marker or '@pytest.mark.skipif(os.environ.get("CI") == "true")' guard; bare @pytest.mark.benchmark alone does not escape
Eleven remaining in-scope sites must carry reasoned hang-guard markers; detector runs clean on the full tree
The detector is wired as a DET code-review criterion (CI gate step in _build-and-test.yml) with teaching messages and self-excludes its own unit-test fixtures via EXCLUDED_FILES
